name: Audio Player
author: KryonOS Team
description: High-fidelity digital audio player for LilyGO T-Deck Plus and KryonOS devices. Plays MP3 and WAV audio files directly from Internal Flash (/local) or MicroSD (/sd) with real-time spectrum visualizer, trackball navigation, and touch controls.
changelog: Added full MP3 audio playback support with hardware-accelerated Core 0 decoding, dynamic format detection, and unified audio file picker.
